# Refinement counted as a giving

<!-- Generated by build_result_registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

> Counted as a formation that only gives, the splitting of the unit is excluded by dissipation and enclosure wherever anything stands, so rest follows from the fixed-unit theorem, unrefutable as there; arising without end needs openness, and the witnesses that leave it uncounted are fed by it.

`rest-with-refinement-counted` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01

<a id="主张-claim"></a>
## Claim

Let the unit split into split t + 1 finer units across the step from t: counted in the finer unit, each condition stands at split t times its level more than before. Count the refinement as one more formation (Flow.withRefinement, Web.withRefinement: never active, requiring and drawing on nothing), which gives each condition split t times its level and takes nothing. Then balance at the refining unit (Flow.BalancesAt (split + 1)) is exactly the spine's balance of the flow with the refinement counted (Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement). The refinement gives without taking: with it counted, the flow dissipates on a family exactly where its own formations do and the refinement gives the family nothing (Flow.withRefinement_dissipatesOn_iff); across a step enclosed and dissipated on with it counted, the refinement gives no condition anything (Flow.refinement_gives_nothing). So in a world with a census and embodied relata, balanced at the refining unit and, with the refinement counted, dissipative and enclosed at every step from T on, that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted, so neither arising nor ceasing recurs (World.rests_unrefuted_refinement_counted); where arising recurs, no step begins a stretch in which every step is enclosed with the refinement counted (World.arising_opens_refinement_counted). The premises are the spine's, read with the refinement counted: none is added. Without counting it, the same holds wherever the refinement gives nothing: dissipative and enclosed at every step from T on, with the refinement giving no relatum anything from T on, that the world rests from some step on cannot be refuted, so neither arising nor ceasing recurs (World.rests_unrefuted_without_refinement, reading the world from T on by World.after and using the spine's World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed), and arising without end needs openness or the refinement's giving (World.arising_needs_refinement); taking from a family closed from T on does not recur where the refinement gives it nothing from T on (Flow.taking_needs_refinement); a reserve that only falls in the refining unit, where the refinement gives it nothing, is the spine's reserve, an unsupported formation being active at most its reserve times (Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined). The witnesses: in Emission, Alternation and Circulation, and in Asymptote where the unit splits at arbitrarily late steps, the refinement gives at arbitrarily late steps, and in Dwindle it gives the reserve at every step (refinement_feeds_witnesses). Their flows dissipate on every closed family, so what keeps them arising, exchanging, taking or lasting is what the refinement gives.

Canonical source: [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)

<a id="前提与对应-hypotheses-and-correspondence"></a>
## Hypotheses and correspondence

- Resolution: the unit splits into split t + 1 finer units across each step, refining and never coarsening; amounts at each step stay natural numbers of that step's unit. This is a hypothesis of the theorems, not an axiom.
- Counting the refinement: reading the refinement as a formation that gives is a reading, not a theorem. It follows Ren, 11 October 2026: ‘A is right - because of change, there is difference, therefore there are difference in its possibility in its becoming … so in the sense of becoming, the becoming into will have relational difference, or it won't be "becoming"’. The author's reading (AI, adopted on Ren's delegation): an amount is a difference made, so a finer distinction is itself a becoming that something must give. The theorems hold under either reading: Flow.balancesAt_iff_withRefinement is an identity, and the laws without counting the refinement are stated too.
- The world premises: a census of activity and every relatum embodied, as in the rest theorem (continued-change-needs-openness); dissipation and enclosure with the refinement counted are the spine's dissipation and enclosure, applied to the flow with the refinement counted.

The rest theorem at a fixed unit (continued-change-needs-openness, World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed, World.arising_opens) is the case where the refinement gives nothing. rest-at-every-resolution shows that, without counting the refinement, the unit's quantum carries rest: every other premise holds while arising never ceases (Emission, Alternation). This result shows those witnesses are not counterexamples to rest but enclosed worlds with a source: counted, the refinement gives without taking, which the spine's dissipation excludes, so, with no premise added, the fixed-unit rest theorem and ‘arising without end needs openness’ apply wherever anything stands. This answers Ren's ‘for the case of 0, why can't we have it?’ of 11 October 2026, read by the author as the case of zero premises (Ren confirmed it). The content is the reading, not new dynamics: in an enclosed world, wherever something stands, dissipation and enclosure with the refinement counted exclude the refinement itself; inside an enclosure the refinement is a source.

<a id="检验与边界-validation-and-boundaries"></a>
## Validation and boundaries

Successful Lean 4.29.1 consolidated check (20261013T094743.528770Z): the 261 declarations of Becoming.Resolution all have empty axiom reports, 29 of them this result's (first compiled from the prelude in a scratch tree against the committed core sources, each checked with #print axioms); the same receipt covers the package's 75 modules over a core closure of 77, every source declaration with an empty axiom report, and checks that the core compiles from Lean's prelude alone; periphery receipt 20261013T095049.338744Z passed. Not yet independently reviewed; the author's counterreview is in section 59.4 of the integration note.

Discrete steps; the unit refines and never coarsens, amounts being rationals by refinement, with neither real amounts nor continuous time; counting the refinement is a reading (Ren's direction, the author's elaboration adopted on Ren's delegation), not derived; the flow with the refinement counted has Option formations and is not a world of one kind of relatum, so rest follows from the spine's theorem through the world read from T on, not by applying it to a counted world directly; ‘does not recur’ is a negated recurrence, not a step after which nothing happens; ‘the case of 0’ means zero premises, as Ren confirmed; no premise added means none added to the spine's, whose dissipation (the least loss per exchange, which Ren reads as entropy) stays its premise; no ethical predicate; not yet independently reviewed.

- The boundary without counting the refinement: Emission and Alternation have a census, embodied relata, balance at a halving unit, dissipation and every step enclosed, and arise without end (rest-at-every-resolution); by this result the refinement gives to them at arbitrarily late steps (refinement_feeds_witnesses), so neither is a counterexample to rest with the refinement counted. Counted, they do not dissipate where enclosed: the refinement is a source. [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
- Asymptote and Circulation: the closed pool is taken from at arbitrarily late steps, and the refinement gives to it at arbitrarily late steps (Flow.taking_needs_refinement, refinement_feeds_witnesses); Dwindle: the reserve falls in the finer unit at each step without reaching zero, and the refinement gives to it at every step (Web.CarriesIn.lasts_unrefined, refinement_feeds_witnesses). [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)

## Dependencies and related results

World.rests_unrefuted_without_refinement and World.rests_unrefuted_refinement_counted read the world from T on (World.after) and apply the spine's rest theorem World.rests_unrefuted_enclosed to it; World.arising_opens is the case where the refinement gives nothing.
- **formal-reuse**: [rest-at-every-resolution](rest-at-every-resolution.md). Reuses balance at a refining unit (Flow.BalancesAt, Flow.BalancesAt.lowers), the counting of quanta (losses_bound, bounded_not_recurring), the regrouping of products (add_mul_split) and the witnesses (Emission, Alternation, Circulation, Asymptote, Dwindle and their theorems of balance, dissipation, closure and recurrence).

**Output:** In a world with a census, embodied relata, balanced, dissipative and enclosed at every step from some step on, neither arising nor ceasing recurs.

**Input:** Where the refinement gives no relatum anything from T on, the world read from T on is balanced (World.after_balanced), dissipative and enclosed, with a census and embodiment.

**Preserved conditions:** A census of activity; embodied relata; balance at the refining unit; dissipative and enclosed from T on; the refinement giving nothing from T on. [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)


**Output:** Balanced at a refining unit and dissipated on, the family's stock with its takers is within r t times the stock before; where each step q times what remains with k quanta is within q times what was there, the quanta are bounded; the witnesses balance at their units, dissipate, and arise, exchange or take at arbitrarily late steps.

**Input:** Where the refinement gives nothing, r t times the stock is the stock, and every taking step loses one unit.

**Preserved conditions:** Balance at the unit split + 1; dissipation; a closed family without repetition. [Resolution.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Resolution.lean)
